notes.content:
Object Editor
 - Streaming option added

Scene Editor
 - Placement property added
 - Blend property added

Shader Editor
 - Fire and Rain added

Unity 2019.2.3f1

Fixed: Chase direction bug
Fixed: Savegame server connection bug

Unity 2019.2.0f1

Added: Custom colors (Menu => Edit Palette)
Added: 3D import for scenes (AG3 files)
Improved: Video converter for Vertex Mode (compressed data)
Added: Video converter with command line arguments (see editor)
Modified: Blender script updated for 2.8 compatibility
Added: COLORIZATION and BCS (Brightness/Contrast/Saturation) shaders
Added: setIcon function
Added: setShaders and setSceneShaders functions

New shader management (please check your projects for compatibility)

Unity 2019.2.0f1

New available ratio mode more flexible
Ratio property replaced by 2 properties
	- Ratio (Screen < Game)
	- Ratio (Scrnee > Game)
The default configuration is "Scroll" and "Letterbox"

WSA is now UWP

And minor bugs fixed

Unity 2019.1.8f1

[u]Object editor[/u]

- Pack texture size field added (64 to 2048)
- 4 colors palette mode added (useful for shadow animation)

[u]WebGL[/u]

- Crazygames build added

[u]Information about the new palette[/u]

When you use 4 colors, each pack texture is stored as 2 bits layer in one 32 bits texture. So the limit is 16 layers per texture.

You can customize 3 colors for each object. The last color is used for the transparency.

It works on all platforms.


Unity 2018.2.17

Game Analytics SDK support added with 4 functions
 - gaDesign
 - gaProgressionStart
 - gaProgressionComplete
 - gaProgressionFail
popup function added
Symbols added (settings and hasSymbol function)

Unity 2018.2.3f1

- event added: DOOR SKIP 
- playSound has a new parameter (volume)
- AGE use a better compression for textures (50%)
- Unity 2018.1.6f1

Editor

- Add: new dialog for Game Assets

Update

- Fix: update didn't work.

Editor

- add: new project property to preload sounds at start
- add: zip file created for WebGL build

Runtime

- Fix: too many draw calls for the visible path-finding
- Fix: language option removed if only one language
- Fix: graphics are reloaded after changing the quality option
- Add: all sounds can be preloaded at start

Unity

- Project name changed
